# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest revision on the default branch is actively supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public Issue, pull request, discussion, or chat.

1. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting:
   <https://github.com/roso-lab/eai-simulator/security/advisories/new>.
2. If you are an internal maintainer, you may instead open a confidential GitLab issue.
3. Verify that the report is private before submitting technical details.
4. If no private reporting channel is available, do not submit vulnerability details through a
   public channel. Contact a maintainer first and ask for a private channel.

Include the affected version or branch, vulnerability type, potential impact, reproduction steps,
relevant logs, a minimal proof of concept when available, and any suggested mitigation.

## Coordinated Disclosure

Keep the report and related technical details confidential until the maintainers confirm that
disclosure is appropriate. Validation, remediation, and disclosure will be coordinated in the
Confidential Issue. This project does not promise a fixed response or remediation deadline.

## Non-Security Issues

Use public GitHub Issues for ordinary bugs, documentation problems, and feature requests.
